articles.title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks amid Wall Street's blockchain race
articles.snippet: Avalanche will serve as the core settlement ledger for the exchange's planned blockchain stock market

articles.title: Zcash developers want 20-second blocks just days after major speed upgrade
articles.snippet: Early data shows Zcash's orphan-block rate holding close to pre-upgrade levels despite blocks arriving three times faster, encouraging developers to push for another reduction.

articles.title: Live news: Crypto prices give ground even as stocks and gold surge, oil plunges
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq, S&P 500, and DJIA all closed more than 2% higher despite Nvidia's steep decline on CEO Jensen Huang's personal issues.

articles.title: HIVE’s Bitcoin output jumps 49%, but mining revenue still falls
articles.snippet: HIVE’s mining revenue fell 7.4% despite higher production, while its AI hosting business grew 71%.

articles.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
articles.snippet: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.
